sloka: हनूमता दत्तवरैर्हतं मधुवनं बलात् ।वयं च जानुभिः कृष्टा देवमार्गं च दर्शिताः ।। ५.६२.१७ ।।।।
transliteration: hanūmatā dattavarairhataṁ madhuvanaṁ balāt ।vayaṁ ca jānubhiḥ kṛṣṭā devamārgaṁ ca darśitāḥ ।। 5.62.17 ।।।।

translations.english: Permitted by Hanuman (to enter Madhuvanam and drink), they dragged one another forcefully tossed up on their knees showing their private parts.
